Passionate veterinarian dedicated to improving the lives of farmer communities. With a focus on providing essential farm services & compassionate animal care, I lead a dynamic team that works tirelessly to support farmers. Committed to fostering a healthier coexistence between agriculture & animal welfare.

For any query, collaboration or for having a conversation with Dr Ashwani Bassan please WhatsApp ‘Hi’ to us on +91 6005303840, or email to us at talktodrashwani@gmail.com or. Our dedicated team will look into your query & respond shortly.
